name: instep-3d
description: A 3D precision rhythm arcade runner that runs in under 3KB as a self-contained Data URI with procedural synth audio and multi-lane beat hopping. Built for Hack Club Bites.

scripts.dev: node -e "import('http').then(h => h.createServer((req, res) => { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': 'text/html'}); res.end(require('fs').readFileSync('dist/one-line-game.html')); }).listen(8080, () => console.log('Serving InStep 3D on http://localhost:8080')));"

author: Akshit
